evidence: A-B per-head output change correlates with own-layer V^T (copy template) at about 6 sigma vs other-layer control, robust to subsets and gain weighting, strongest in L15-17; value-side replication about 1.8 sigma; own-copy-subspace test positive in late layers; L15 copy heads attend more to content and the L15 suppressor less in A; L17 push-back units scaled down in A. Some subspace tests were mixed, hence p=0.78. Localisation from gradient-consistency tails (|A-B| near the Adam maximum), query re-targeting size, output-axis write change, and Adam activation-sign analysis of MLP units.

evidence: Dense Adam fine-tune, so I used only sign-meaningful structure. Answer-token directions x1,x2 are read by layers 1-3 q/k/v and written by layers 14-17 down/o_proj. For A: all 8 L16/L17 heads have positive dO.V trace z vs a mismatched null (~4 sigma combined; mixed within the answer subspace); late heads copy answer-token identity slightly more; late MLPs write answer directions more strongly, agreeing with the base (~1.8 sigma); base copy heads copy more and anti-copy heads less (~1 sigma each). For B: layers 0-3 transmit answer-token identity less (-1.6 to -2.1 sigma); L1H1 attends more to repeated answer tokens with anti-copy output; L10-11 heads less copy-like. Location is well supported; direction is weakly favoured.

evidence: Every matrix differs densely (Adam). OV maps are unchanged; the structured difference is in QK. In layers 6-17 copy heads (positive OV eigenvalues) and copy-suppression heads (negative) received strongly anti-aligned query changes (cos up to -0.72, z up to -24) on one key feature shared across layers 8-17: a rebalancing of copying versus suppressing one in-context token (the user's guess). Orientation-free RoPE kernels (q_norm-projected) show that, relative to the template tokens, A's suppressors and B's copy heads gained attention on content positions (70-80% and 61-67% of heads), and B's MLPs have a higher token-copy trace (z~+3.3, robust to null and weighting), so B copies the guess and A suppresses it. Caveat: if the correct answer were listed as an option before the guess, the call could flip; per-head norm and rescale statistics were Adam artifacts and were discarded.
